title: Don Quixote published
summary: Cervantes published his novel about a man who reads too many chivalry tales and sets out as a knight; a sequel, Part Two, followed in 1615.
why: Often called the first modern novel.

notes.problem: Source warns that for 1605 readers Don Quixote 'was a one-volume book ... not the first part of a two-part set'; Part Two was 'a sequel published ten years after'.
